mapper.update: UPDATE activity_comments SET content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER}
UPDATE activity_comments SET is_deleted = true WHERE id = #{id,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_comments c WHERE c.activity_id = #{activityId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} AND c.is_deleted = false AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM content_takedowns t WHERE t.content_type = 'ACTIVITY_COMMENT' AND t.content_id = c.id AND t.restored_at IS NULL )

SELECT c.activity_id, COUNT(*) AS comment_count FROM activity_comments c JOIN activities a ON a.id = c.activity_id WHERE a.trip_id = #{tripId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} AND c.is_deleted = false AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM content_takedowns t WHERE t.content_type = 'ACTIVITY_COMMENT' AND t.content_id = c.id AND t.restored_at IS NULL ) GROUP BY c.activity_id
